$comment: Parity cases for parity.test.ts (agent/plans/PLAN-rmcp-decide.md box D6). Each case names a row of packages/shared/src/policy/__fixtures__/decision-table.json by id; that row supplies the principal, the command, the target, the policy and the hand-written expectation, so no expectation is repeated here. A case adds only which `surfaces` can express the row. The CLI and the local MCP server judge a local-file config as its owner, the MCP child is always an agent, and an env opt-in counts only when the process ancestry proves a human set it, so a row with a member role or an env opt-in runs on `decide` and `executor` only, a human row never on `mcp`, and a command the MCP server does not expose (`repo resize`) never on `mcp`. `executorDeviation` pins the one place the executor answers differently on purpose (serve/policy.ts noPolicyGrandRefusal): the case is held to that answer, not skipped.

executorDeviation.why: with no policy document the executor fails closed on a grand repo whatever the role
